analysis.reason: Test expected HTTP 200 for a positive case (/products/1) per the test case and contract checks, but the API returned HTTP 404 with response {"message":"Requested item not found"}. This indicates the service did not return the expected product resource.
analysis.recommendedAction: Verify test data and environment (confirm product with ID 1 exists in the test database). If data is present, investigate the application: check API routing/handlers, database queries, and recent deployments; review server logs for why the item was not found; run the same request against a known-good environment or with direct DB verification to distinguish missing data vs. implementation bug.
